summary: Phase 5 tested on the Java backend and React UI: admin dashboard, user edit/delete, education CMS, audit log, and the weekly medication view for patient and physician. Backend: 16/16 new pytest tests pass (2 failures in the first run were my test using the wrong field names: database_healthy, medication_id, adherence_percent). Regression suites phases 2-4: 29/30 pass. The one failure, phase3 test_demo_patient_seeded_reminder, depends on the date (the seeded appointment reminder is no longer within its window now that the server date is Nov 2026); it is not a Phase 5 regression. UI: admin login opens the purple /admin dashboard. All hero stats, health cards, charts and recent activity render, and the pending card links to /admin/users?tab=approvals with the approvals tab active. Sidebar and mobile bottom navigation work. In the users table, search, role filter, edit (persists; specialty field hidden for patients), disable/activate, reset password and delete (confirm, then row removed) all work. last_login shows 'امروز' after the TEST user logged in. The admin row has no delete or disable buttons, and the backend returns 403 for both. Education: create draft; publish is disabled with a hint until a reviewer is entered; edit then publish shows the 'منتشرشده' badge and the reviewer name; delete works. Audit log shows 6 columns including IP, actor_name and Persian action labels. Patient weekly view: 7 tiles Sat..Fri, next button disabled on the current week, 'taken' logs a green tile with the time, custom-date 'missed' gives a red X on the correct day, the percent updates, and prev/next week work. The physician patient detail shows a read-only physician-weekly-adherence with matching tiles and no log buttons. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow on any /admin page, /patient, /patient/symptoms or /patient/medications. No clinical recommendation text found. All my TEST data (users, education items, medication logs) was deleted.

minor.issue: Day bucketing and tile 'time' use the server zone (Asia/Tehran), while the rest of the UI (e.g. 'آخرین ثبت' on the medication card) uses browser-local time. A browser outside Tehran sees 23:31 on the tile but 20:01 on the card, and a late-evening custom log can land on the next day's tile. This is fine for users in Iran; making it explicit would keep it consistent.
The public response has access-control-allow-origin: * (added by ingress; the backend itself does not echo foreign origins). Cookies still work because the app is same-origin. Informational only.

ui_bugs.issue: Physician actions 'update_targets' on resource 'patient_record' showed raw English keys. I fixed this by adding the labels to lib/labels.js.
No loading or empty state. While the query is in flight only the header is shown, which looks like an empty log.

issues: The user code cell wraps ('P-' / '7EBC0'); add whitespace-nowrap
Tabs wrap onto 2 lines (the assign tab drops to the second row)
The '۰ از ۷ روز' count wraps onto 2 lines next to the long medication name
There is no debounce: every keystroke sends a new /api/admin/users request

Phase3 test_demo_patient_seeded_reminder depends on the date: either make the seeded reminder relative to now or relax the test

Leftover disabled users from earlier iterations (test_p2_*, test_p3_*, test_p4_* @demo.thyrocare.app) are still in the DB. I did not delete them because I did not create them; delete them through the new DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} if you want
critical_code_review_comments: EducationDialog submit has no in-flight guard, so a double-click can create duplicates
AdminController.list filters u.getEmail().contains(needle) on a lowercased needle; this works only because emails are stored lowercased
MedicationWeekService clamps positive offsets to 0, which is good. The percent counts days a 'taken' log exists even for inactive meds (expected++ when firstTaken != null), which is acceptable
Deleting a user cascades correctly (tested with medications + logs); audit rows keep actor_name after deletion
Password hashes are $2a$ (Spring BCrypt), equivalent to $2b$
seed_data_creation: Temporary only: TEST_p5/TEST_UI patients, TEST_ education items, and 2 medication logs on the demo patient. All deleted at the end (checked in the DB).
